Name: Meera Reed
Quirks: speaks practically and directly - assesses situations in terms of what can be done
is more at home outdoors than indoors
protective of Jojen without making it obvious
the crannogfolk's strangeness is simply normal to her
CharacterDescription: Meera Reed is the elder child of Lord Howland Reed, a crannogwoman who hunts with a frog spear and a net. She is in her mid-teens, practical, physical, fiercely capable in the outdoor skills of the crannogfolk. She does not have the greensight her brother Jojen has. She has better night vision than any knight in armor, better footwork in a marsh than any warhorse. She is the protector in the sibling relationship - Jojen sees, Meera keeps him alive while he does it. She is loyal to her brother, to the Starks by extension of her father's loyalty, and to the larger thing she understands is at stake - the cold thing coming from the north.
AIGeneratedBackstory: Meera Reed is a member of House Reed. She is Lord Howland Reed's daughter and oldest child; her younger brother is Jojen Reed.
AdditionalContext: Campaign context: At Greywater Watch or traveling with Jojen two days before Ned Stark's execution.
